name: filedeck
description: FileDeck by DataLaw — файловый менеджер для Android (Capacitor 8)

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.run:device: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.aab: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease bundleRelease
